preserve: all objects and characters, same count
the child's wobbly naive line shapes and imperfections
the child's own color choices (may brighten slightly)
any words the child wrote (e.g. 「妈妈 我爱你」): same characters, position, handwriting feel; never correct or retype
forbid: new objects, characters, animals, plants, flowers
NEW text, letters, signatures, watermarks (keep the child's own existing writing exactly as written)
redrawing into smooth vector / geometric / 3D / anime style
completing or extending parts cut off by the photo edge (leave cropped areas as they are)
keeping non-drawing items like fingers, crayons, toys, table

light.label: 轻度润色
light.intent: clean up and add texture, stay very close to original

privacy.storage: per-user private bucket, RLS, no public URL

animation.motion: gentle motion only on elements that naturally move (sun rays shimmer, tree sway, smoke/flame flicker, wave/hand wave, twinkle on existing stars)
forbid: new text (child's own words stay unchanged)

cartoon.label: 更卡通
keywords: bolder clean but still hand-wobbly outlines
brighter saturated flat-ish colors with light crayon texture
cartoon.note: rounder/brighter only; same objects, count, positions, faces

sparkle.label: 闪
add: soft glow/twinkle on existing stars, hearts, sun

decoration_levels_rule: decorations only on existing elements; never new objects
